description:
Offers in Excess of €349,000

Ardilea is a charming 4 bedroom detached bungalow with large sunroom and beautiful mature rear garden which benefits from a generous "concrete standing area" (perfect for parking a motor home or storing a boat!). 
Accommodation includes; 4 bedrooms (main ensuite), a family bathroom, a large livingroom, a huge kitchen, a utility room and  a sunroom.

The property is set back from the road on the Kilmore Quay side of Kilmore Village.  Amenities in the village include a National School, Church, The famous Mary Barry's Seafood Restaurant, Quigleys Bar and bus links into Wexford Town.

Easily accessible by car is Bridgetown Vocational School, Kilmore National School, numerous sandy beaches, the pretty village of Kilmore Quay , St. Helens and Rosslare Golf Clubs, the historic town of Wexford and the Europort in Rosslare Harbour.

All in all a great family home with easy access to many amenities!
